source_note: 现存表书院建于庆长三年（1598），是三宝院的国宝建筑。 图版依据寺方实拍绘表书院外观，不与三宝院唐门混为一处。
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a Fanggu heritage line plate. Image 1 is the actual monument PHOTO and controls geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project black fine-contour STYLE sample; never transfer its Buddha subject. Draw the named Japanese building accurately as a complete, isolated elevation at nearly frontal view. Fine sparse black ink contours with a few structural lines; no broad dark fills, hatching, pencil grain or opaque silhouettes. Pure flat opaque WHITE #FFFFFF canvas, including every blank region inside and outside the subject. Center with generous margins. No shadow, gradient, texture, glow, checkerboard, color, text, labels, signage, people, foliage, surrounding buildings, watermark or frame. Subject: Daigo-ji Sanbo-in OMOTE SHOIN, the ACTUAL 1598 main drawing-room building shown across the garden in the temple archive photo. Preserve long one-story tiled roof, projecting entrance/gable at one end, row of sliding doors and raised veranda. Isolate the architecture; do not substitute the Sanbo-in Karamon or depict the pond.
